description: Convert a local wall-clock time in one place to another place. Reports nonexistent (DST gap) and ambiguous (DST overlap) times.

disambiguation.description: Which instant to use for an ambiguous time. Default earlier.

from.description: Place or zone of the given time.

time.description: Local time without offset in the "from" place, "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM", e.g. "2026-12-01T13:30".

name: convert_time
title: Uhrzeit umrechnen
